subject: english
question: Identify the most suitable title for the passage.

options.text: How Safe Are We on this Earth?

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Industrial Threats**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Seismic Depression"** refers to a significant lowering or sinking of the Earth's surface due to seismic activity. (भूकंपीय अवसाद)

 
 
• **Example: **The region experienced a seismic depression after the earthquake, causing widespread damage.
 
 
 
• **"Industrial Threats"** refers to dangers or risks posed by industrial activities, which can include pollution, accidents, and other hazards. (औद्योगिक खतरे)
 
 
• **Example: **The chemical spill was one of the worst industrial threats the city had ever faced.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Industrial Threats**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Seismic Depression** (भूकंपीय अवसाद): Significant lowering or sinking of the Earth's surface due to seismic activity.

 
 
• **Example:** The region experienced a seismic depression after the earthquake, causing widespread damage.
 
 
 
• **How Safe Are We on this Earth?** (हम इस पृथ्वी पर कितने सुरक्षित हैं?): A general inquiry about the safety and security of human life on Earth.
 
 
• **Example:** The documentary titled "How Safe Are We on this Earth?" explores various natural and man-made threats.
 
 
 
• **Man Vs Man** (मनुष्य बनाम मनुष्य): A situation or narrative focusing on conflicts between individuals or groups of people.
 
 
• **Example:** The novel is a classic example of a man vs man conflict, highlighting the struggles between two rival factions.
